scientific_integrity: Analytical theorem with explicit renewal proof; numerical checker is finite corroboration, not independent proof.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional OU; fixed k1>=0,k2>0; independent positive clock W with finite second moment; r tends to infinity pointwise. No stability of finite-rate ordering or general clock optimization claimed.
title: Sharp \(r^{-3/2}\) clock-moment law for stochastic-return Ornstein–Uhlenbeck search
